name: Nemesis Gnosis

skills.name: Starfall
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% attack to them.

skills.name: Calamity Resonance
skills.description:
Select 1 enemy target within 9 tiles of the user and deal Corrosion damage equal to 100% of attack, then gains Doom Mark for 2 turns, Insight for 2 turns, and Extra Command.
If Nemesis has Fifth Prophecy: Startrack, the range of Action Support from Doom Mark is changed to the entire battlefield.

skills.name: Prismatic Refraction
skills.description:
Selects 1 enemy target within a 9-tile radius and deals Corrosion Damage equal to 120% of attack.
If Nemesis has First Prophecy: Resonance, damage multiplier is increased by 20%, and gains 1 stack of Focus before skill usage.
If Nemesis has Second Prophecy: Solitude, damage dealt is increased by 20% when there are no allied units within a 4-tile radius of the user. After skill usage, restores HP equal to 15% of max HP.

skills.name: Destiny Unfolding
skills.description:
Selects 1 enemy target within a 9-tile radius and deals AoE Corrosion Damage equal to 140% of attack to the target and all enemy units within a 1-tile radius around it, consuming all Confectance Index. For each 1 point of Confectance Index consumed, the damage is increased by 10%, and deals 1 point of stability damage.
If the user has Sixth Prophecy: Event Horizon, then for each 1 point of Confectance Index consumed, damage dealt is additionally increased by 10%, and all enemy targets within a 3-tile radius around the target additionally take AoE Corrosion Damage equal to 100% of attack and 1 point of stability damage.

skills.name: Whispers of Nirvana
skills.description:
Damage dealt to Paradeus enemies is increased is increased by 20%.
Upon the first use of the Active skill Calamity Resonance, if there are allied units within a 4-tile radius of Nemesis, gains First Prophecy: Resonance; if there are no allied units within a 4-tile radius of Nemesis, gains Second Prophecy: Solitude.
At the start of battle, if there are normal enemy units on the field, gains Third Prophecy: Calamity; if there are no normal enemy units on the field, gains Fourth Prophecy: Judgment.
If there are 2 allied Dolls using sniper rifles or 2 allied Corrosion Dolls on the field, Nemesis gains Fifth Prophecy: Startrack. If there are 4 allied Dolls using sniper rifles on the field, all allied Dolls using sniper rifles gain Sixth Prophecy: Event Horizon.

fortification.effect: Doom Mark effect enhanced: the damage multiplier is increased to 110%, the number of Action Support triggers is increased by 1, and an additional 1 point of Confectance Index is restored.
Cooldown is reduced by 1 turn, and the damage multiplier is increased to 200%. If Nemesis has Fifth Prophecy: Startrack, damage dealt is increased by 50%.

First Prophecy: Resonance effect enhanced: Focus can stack without limit and is not removed when mobility points are consumed.
Second Prophecy: Solitude effect enhanced: Omen is replaced with Prophet.

If Nemesis has First Prophecy: Resonance, the damage multiplier is increase is raised from 20% to 40%.
If Nemesis has Second Prophecy: Solitude, and there are no allied units within a 4-tile radius of Nemesis, damage dealt is increase is raised from 20% to 40%, and the HP restored after skill usage is increased from 15% to 30%.

Third Prophecy: Calamity effect enhanced: the damage multiplier is increased to 80%, and the effective range is expanded by 1 tile.
Fourth Prophecy: Judgment effect enhanced: the additional increase to the damage multiplier of Action Support is raised to 40%. When attacking Elite or Boss units, the Adjudication Privilege effect that ignores the target's defense is increased to 35%, the increase of Critical Damage is raised to 40%. Additionally, damage dealt is increased by 20%.

Fifth Prophecy: Startrack effect enhanced: the range requirement for ignoring Cover when dealing targeted damage under Stellar Insight is removed. The increase to damage dealt for every 1 tile of distance from the target is increased to 10%, up to a maximum of 60%.
Sixth Prophecy: Event Horizon effect enhanced: the first Action Support triggered by Doom Mark each turn is replaced with the use of the Ultimate skill Destiny Unfolding, and it is treated as consuming all Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Return Anchor
keys.effect: At the start of battle, gains 3 points of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Wise Judgment
keys.effect: When having First Prophecy: Resonance, the range of Starfall, Calamity Resonance,Prismatic Refraction, and Destiny Unfolding is increased by 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 -  Nomad Instinct
keys.effect: When having Second Prophecy: Solitude, if Nemesis defeats a target, gains Stealth for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 -  Immune Bloodline
keys.effect: When having First Prophecy: Resonance, after performing Action Support, dispels 1 buff from the target.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Prophet’s Monologue
keys.effect: When having Second Prophecy: Solitude, mobility is increased by 2 tiles. After using the Prismatic Refraction, gains 4 tiles of Additional Movement.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Blessing of Nirvana
keys.effect: Upon every use (not only first use) of Calamity Resonance, if there are allied units within 4 tiles to Nemesis, she gains First Prophecy: Resonance; if there are no allied units within 4 tiles to Nemesis, she gains Second Prophecy: Solitude. Only 1 of either First Prophecy: Resonance or Second Prophecy: Solitude can exist at a time.

keys.name: Common Key - Will of Vengeance
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / At the start of battle, if there are 2 allied Dolls using sniper rifles or 2 allied Corrosion Dolls on the field, damage dealt is increased by 10%.
